title: Complete the Matt artifact lifecycle
outcome: Repository adapters give Matt playbooks a complete operational, Change-scoped, and canonical artifact lifecycle ending in branch-local Archive.
acceptanceCriteria: Installed Matt skill files remain vendor-managed and repository policy lives in WORKFLOW.md plus docs/agents adapters.
Pre-PR review evidence updates Blueprint Review before developer acceptance.
Structured ADRs remain in Change Design through implementation and are copied to the narrowest Feature only when Archive verifies them.
Branch-local Archive promotes verified knowledge and freezes the Change before the pull request opens.
Operational tracker and handoff artifacts may expire without breaking durable Blueprint knowledge.
